review_notes: I read the whole file. The only definitions are weightedTranslationResidueQuotientMap and its Nilmanifold-space wrapper weightedTranslationResiduePhaseQuotientMap. The first is a set-level map between coset spaces. It is built from `Quotient.map` and `QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply`. I searched Mathlib's GroupTheory directory for an existing induced map on non-normal coset spaces and found none. `QuotientGroup.map` needs normal subgroups. `quotientMapOfLE` only covers the case where both quotients are of the same group and the subgroups are nested. The Mathlib uses of `Quotient.map'` that I found are for particular constructions, not a general hom-induced map on `G ⧸ H`. The Nilmanifold wrapper just fixes the nilmanifold-space type, which is a deliberate named specialisation and does not add a competing concept. I did not open the imported OAI nilmanifold files, so I did not check whether the project's own definitions overlap with Mathlib. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
